First Solar (FSLR) Shareholder Liberty Mutual Group Asset Management Has Cut Holding; Maple Capital Management Has Lowered Its Diageo Plc Spon Adr (DEO) Holding by $315,495 as Stock Value Rose
June 29, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Maple Capital Management Inc decreased its stake in Diageo Plc Spon Adr (DEO) by 46.21% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Maple Capital Management Inc sold 2,337 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.97% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 2,720 shares of the beverages (production and distribution) company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $368,000, down from 5,057 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Maple Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Diageo Plc Spon Adr for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $89.30 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.29% or $1.83 during the last trading session, reaching $144. About 459,583 shares traded. Diageo plc (NYSE:DEO) has risen 20.09% since June 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.52% the S&P500.
